records.reviewed_statement: Law 7.1 supplies the standard scheduled 2 x 45 regulation minutes. Prior referee/team agreement AND competition-rule permission are needed for reduction. Added time, penalty completion and abandonment qualify actual play; interval, extra time and shoot-outs are not the scheduled regulation duration. records.source_edition: 2026/27; section 8 adopted 1 June 2026; current-handbook landing confirms season; section 21 edition-specific PDF
records.reviewed_statement: A1/A1.1 require clubs/affiliated associations to conform to Laws defined as IFAB. B9.2 requires competition-rule compliance; J1.5 adopts IFAB annual commencement. These incorporate Laws, not an explicit 90-minute statement. THE_FA is the national governing authority, not the National League operator. Local TEST admission/re-review limit only: seven days from this new review, not an official document expiry. No historical or other-season validity.

retained_source_content.applicability_statement: Section 21 defines NLS leagues as sanctioned competitions and binds their clubs/leagues; its regulation 3.1 diagram locates National League at Step 1, North/South at Step 2. It does not validate North/South, Cup, FA Cup, youth, friendlies or all English football. Edition selection is a dated reviewer inference from J1.5 and IFAB effective date. IFAB qualifications remain; no reviewed duration derogation was identified. Local TEST admission/re-review limit only: seven days from this new review, not an official document expiry.
